design_policy: Every searchable Legal Issue has an explicit feature pack. Matter Type may route additional domain facts, but Legal Issue packs are the primary unit for LLM feature annotation.

units.money: Use USD when the opinion uses dollars or omits currency in a U.S. case; otherwise preserve the stated currency. Store numeric amount without commas and preserve an evidence quote.
units.dates: Use ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD when a full date is stated; use YYYY or YYYY-MM when only partial dates are stated; do not infer missing month or day.
units.percentages: Store as numeric percent, e.g. 12.5 for 12.5%.
units.time_periods: Normalize as a number plus unit: days, months, years, hours, minutes. Preserve the original text.
units.citations: Normalize U.S.C. citations as '<title> USC <section>' when explicit, e.g. 42 USC 1983. Preserve state statute text if normalization is uncertain.
units.standards: Use only closed standard-of-review values when a feature asks for a review standard.

not_mentioned_policy.rule: If the opinion does not mention a requested field, do not infer it from the issue label, caption, or general legal knowledge.
not_mentioned_policy.output: Use status='not_mentioned' inside the feature value object, or null for scalar value plus reason='not_mentioned'.
not_mentioned_policy.evidence: Evidence must be empty when the field is not mentioned.

assertion_scope_gate: Party arguments may show the issue was raised, but they do not prove the court decided it.
Legal standards, statutory definitions, quoted cases, and citation parentheticals cannot prove case-specific facts.
For outcome features, use current court holding or current court analysis. If only background or party argument exists, mark not_mentioned or not_reached.
